Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patient who submitted a written informed consent for this trial, and 18 ~ 90 years old
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is 53 years old and has provided written informed consent, meeting both age and consent requirements.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patient who have naïve ampulla (no previous procedure was performed at ampulla)
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about any previous procedures performed at the ampulla.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patient who is suspected to have biliary obstruction or biliary disease
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's medical history does not mention any suspicion of biliary obstruction or biliary disease.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patient who is needed to have endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography for treatment of biliary obstruction
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information indicating a need for endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography for biliary obstruction.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patient who have risks of post-endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography pancreatitis among bellows (at least one more); 1. suspected biliary sphincter of Oddi dysfunction 2. young age (18~50 years) 3. female 4. normal common bile duct diameter (≤9mm) 5. normal serum bilirubin level 6. Obesity (body mass index > 30) 7. Past history of acute pancreatitis
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is female, which is one risk factor, but there is no information on the other risk factors such as common bile duct diameter, serum bilirubin level, BMI, or history of acute pancreatitis.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patient who is below 18 year old
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is 53 years old, so this criterion is not violated.
There is no information indicating that the patient is pregnant.
There is no information suggesting the patient has mental retardation.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patient is sensitive to contrast agents
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information indicating sensitivity to contrast agents.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patient who received sphincterotomy or pancreatobiliary operation previously
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about any previous sphincterotomy or pancreatobiliary operations.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patient who have ampulla of Vater cancer
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has lung cancer, not ampulla of Vater cancer.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patient who have difficulty for approach to ampulla due to abdominal surgery including stomach cancer with Billroth II anastomosis
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information indicating difficulty in approaching the ampulla due to abdominal surgery.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patient who have pancreatic diseases as bellow (at least one more); 1. Patient who have acute pancreatitis within 30days before enrollment 2. Patient who have idiopathic acute recurrent pancreatitis 3. Patient who have pancreatic divisum 4. Patient who have obstructive chronic pancreatitis 5. Patient who pancreatic cancer
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information indicating the patient has any of the listed pancreatic diseases.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients who have improper ampulla shape as bellows; 1. Small ampulla (ampulla without oral protrusion) 2. Flat or crooked or asymmetric ampulla 3. Ampulla with peri-ampullary diverticulum type I or II
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about the shape of the patient's ampulla.

Recap: The patient meets the age and consent requirements for inclusion. However, there is insufficient information to determine if the patient has a naïve ampulla, is suspected of having biliary obstruction or disease, or needs endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography. The patient is female, which is one risk factor for post-procedure pancreatitis, but other risk factors are unclear. No exclusion criteria are violated based on the provided information.
